input.quote: This Agreement shall be governed and construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of New York applicable to contracts made and to be performed exclusively in that State without giving effect to the principles of conflict of laws.
input.rationale: Governing law is New York, which is our preferred position, and there is no arbitration clause; however Section 10.5 is silent on venue, leaving forum open to dispute. We added exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County without otherwise altering the sentence.

input.quote: This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by, the parties hereto and their respective legal representatives, successors and assigns, but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 10.3 is a bare successors-and-assigns clause with no consent standard, so HDI could freely assign the development and hosting of our branded Site — potentially to a competitor such as those named in Section 6 — while our own affiliate/M&A rights are not expressly protected. We added our affiliate/successor assignment right, confirmed no change-of-control right for HDI, and required our consent (not unreasonably withheld) for HDI assignments, never to a competitor.
